notes: Save ladder route: the harness installs the rung's save as slot 9 (-SaveFile, save_slot below). 게임 계속하기 (Continue) loads the journey with the newest save date inside the file (the user's own), so the route goes 게임 로딩 (Load Game) > the save list (newest first by that date; every community save is older than the user's journeys, so it is the last entry: scroll to the end, hover it, E) > 확인. A cleared save then asks 새 라운드 (new round / NG+): always 취소, which loads the save as it is; 확인 there would start NG+. In the list R deletes a save (never). Then the loading screen > shrine > play (WASD, Shift sprint, Space dodge, Ctrl jump, LMB/RMB attacks, V staff spin, 1/2 spells, mouse camera; never E at the shrine, Q items, R gourd, P photo mode, M map) > Esc > D until the 설정 tab (the tab count grows with progress: 5 tabs early, 6 with 근기, so tabs are never clicked by position) > 게임 종료 > 바탕 화면으로 > 확인. On the keyboard settings page R resets the bindings (never). five_saves checks the list shows 5 saves (the user's 4 journeys + slot 9); if the user adds or deletes a journey, re-save it (and check the last entry is still at the same place). The first start after an update compiles shaders for about a minute.

steps.note: 게임 로딩 (Load Game), hovered first: the highlight shows the click will hit it
the installed save is the oldest: scroll the list to its end with the mouse over it, then the last entry sits under the mouse
a cleared save asks to start a new round (NG+): 취소 loads it as it is

the loading screen (20-60 s) animates its bottom ornament (the icon and the swirls fade out, at times all of it for 5 s and more), so the band behind the tip title (loading_band, the same on every tip) decides; play starts when neither has shown for 5 s
